name: link
description: Navigates to another page or location. For an action on the current page use button.

use.when: it goes somewhere: a page, a record, a block on its own.
use.not: an action on this page, which is a button.
use.with: text that says where it leads.

label.description: Says where it leads, never 'click here'.

context.title: Extra words for screen readers
context.description: Words read after the label, not shown, so Edit reads as Edit card.

current.title: This is the current page
current.description: It points at the page being viewed.

within.title: The page being viewed is inside where it leads
within.description: The page being viewed is under where it leads, such as a record of its list. current wins over it.

look.title: How it looks
look.description: button is a link standing on its own, shaped as a quiet button so it is easy to press: the way back, the list behind a block.

keyboard.does: moves focus to and from the link

wcag.notes: Link text is meaningful out of context (2.4.9), with context filling in the rest of the name when the visible label is compact. Underlined so colour is not the only cue (1.4.1). 7:1 contrast. A link is never a small target: in a sentence its hit area reaches half a line above and below; on its own it takes the button look and the 44px target; in a row or a chip it fills the row or chip (2.5.8).

machine.identify: The accessible name is the visible label plus any context text. The href attribute is the destination.
machine.operate: Click it, or focus it and press Enter. Read aria-current: page is the current page, true is the place the current page is in.
